title: Checkpoint
description: A signed, ordered point a session can be resumed from. The evidence IS the `envelope` (a DSSE-wrapped in-toto Statement, same shape a gate result uses); the other fields are a queryable projection of it. Resume verifies the envelope AND re-derives `state`'s digest before forking a workspace — an unverified resume would make 'one continuous signed history' false while looking true.

seq.description: Monotonic within a session. Unique per (session_id, seq), so two harnesses checkpointing at once cannot silently reorder each other.

harness.description: The harness that wrote this checkpoint.

state.description: Opaque harness-supplied resume state. ADP never parses it or branches on it, so a harness storing its own format needs no ADP change. Covered by the signature via the SHA-256 digest in the statement's predicate.

envelope.description: DSSE envelope over an in-toto Statement with predicateType https://adp.dev/attestations/checkpoint/v1. The subject digest is `git_sha`; the predicate carries sessionId, seq, harness, and stateSha256.
